errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: The request couldn't be processed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This no longer exists, it may have been deleted in another window. Reload the page.
errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This action isn't possible here. Reload the page and try again.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED_CLIENT: The server rejected this request. Check INTERNAL_TOKEN in .env and restart the app.
errors.SERVICE_STARTING: The app is still starting. This usually takes a few seconds.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server ran into an error. Try again in a moment.
errors.UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: This file is larger than {max_mb} MB. Split it or use a smaller version.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: This format isn't supported. You can add PDF, TXT, Markdown and HTML files.
errors.FILE_CONTENT_MISMATCH: The content doesn't match the file extension. Save it again as PDF, TXT, Markdown or HTML.
errors.EMPTY_FILE: This file is empty. Choose a different file.
errors.DUPLICATE_DOCUMENT: This file is already in your library. You can use it right away.
errors.STORAGE_QUOTA: Your library reached its {max_mb} MB limit. Remove a document to make room.
errors.STORAGE_FULL: The disk is full. Free up some space or remove documents.
errors.UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE: The upload was interrupted. Try again.
errors.DOCUMENT_NOT_READY: This document is still being processed. Try again shortly.
errors.DOCUMENT_FILE_MISSING: The original file is gone. Add the document again.
errors.DELETE_FAILED: Deleting didn't fully work. Try again, anything already removed stays removed.
errors.RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE: This part of the file doesn't exist. Reload the view.
errors.PDF_ENCRYPTED: This PDF is password protected. Save a copy without a password and add it again.
errors.PDF_CORRUPT: This PDF can't be opened and may be damaged. Export it again and retry.
errors.PDF_NO_TEXT: This PDF has no readable text, it's probably a scan. Use a version with a text layer or a sharper copy.
errors.PDF_TOO_MANY_PAGES: This PDF has more pages than the app can process. Split it into smaller files.
errors.TEXT_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED: This file's text encoding isn't supported. Save it as UTF-8 and add it again.
errors.DOCUMENT_EMPTY: This file contains no text. Choose a file that contains text.
errors.DOCUMENT_TOO_LONG: This document is too long. Split it into smaller files.
errors.PROCESSING_TIMEOUT: Processing took too long. Try again or split the file.
errors.PROCESSING_FAILED: Something went wrong while processing. Try again.
errors.PROCESSING_INTERRUPTED: Processing was interrupted by a restart. Start it again.
errors.MALWARE_DETECTED: The virus check found malware in this file and deleted it right away. Get a clean copy from a trusted source.
errors.MALWARE_SCAN_FAILED: The virus check couldn't scan this file, so it wasn't added. Try again.
errors.CHAT_NOT_FOUND: This chat no longer exists. It may have been deleted in another window.
errors.CHAT_BUSY: An answer is still being written in this chat. Wait a moment or stop it.
errors.CHAT_LIMIT: You have {max} chats. Delete older ones to start a new chat.
errors.MESSAGE_LIMIT: This chat has gotten very long. Start a new chat for more questions.
errors.MESSAGE_NOT_LATEST: You can only regenerate the answer to the latest question. Ask your question again.
errors.DUPLICATE_REQUEST: This question is already on its way.
errors.CONCURRENCY_LIMIT: {max} answers are already running. You can continue as soon as one finishes.
errors.NO_DOCUMENTS: Add a document first. Then you can ask questions about it.
errors.DOCUMENTS_NOT_READY: Your documents are still being processed. You can ask as soon as one is ready.
errors.QUESTION_TOO_LONG: Your question is longer than {max} characters. Shorten it.
errors.MODEL_NOT_ALLOWED: This model isn't available here. Choose another one above.
errors.COMPARE_SAME_MODEL: Both columns use the same model. Choose two different models to compare.
errors.TOKEN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The daily budget is used up. You can ask again from {time}.
errors.LLM_AUTH: The API key isn't accepted. Check it under Settings > Models.
errors.LLM_KEY_NEEDS_WORKSPACE: This API key doesn't belong to a workspace. Create an API key in a workspace in the Claude Console, or enter the workspace ID under Settings > Models.
errors.LLM_BILLING: The API account's credit or spend limit has been reached. Check billing in the Claude Console.
errors.LLM_FORBIDDEN: This API key can't use the selected model. Pick another model or check access in the Claude Console.
errors.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: {model} isn't available right now. Choose another model.
errors.LLM_RATE_LIMITED: Claude is receiving too many requests from this account. Try again {seconds, plural, =0 {in a moment} one {in one second} other {in # seconds}}.
errors.LLM_OVERLOADED: Claude is very busy right now. Try again in a few seconds or use another model.
errors.LLM_UNAVAILABLE: Claude had a problem just now. Try again shortly.
errors.LLM_TIMEOUT: Claude took too long to respond. Try again.
errors.LLM_UNREACHABLE: Can't reach Claude right now. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.LLM_BAD_REQUEST: Claude couldn't process the request. Start a new chat and try there.
errors.LLM_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE: This chat has gotten too long. Start a new one.
errors.LLM_EMPTY_ANSWER: No answer came back. Try again.
errors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: The server isn't responding right now. The app keeps trying automatically.
errors.FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN: This request didn't come from the app and was blocked. Reload the app and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the app right now. Check that it's still running and try again.
errors.STREAM_INTERRUPTED: The connection dropped before the answer was finished. Try again.
errors.REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: This request is too large. Shorten the text and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. You can continue {seconds, plural, =0 {in a moment} one {in one second} other {in # seconds}}.
errors.API_KEY_INVALID: Anthropic doesn't accept this API key. Check it in the Claude Console and paste it again.
errors.URL_INVALID: That isn't a valid link. You can use http and https addresses without a user name or password.
errors.URL_BLOCKED: This link points into a local or internal network. For safety, the app only loads public addresses.
errors.URL_UNREACHABLE: Nothing could be loaded from the link. Check it and try again.
errors.URL_TIMEOUT: The server behind the link is too slow to answer. Try again later.
errors.URL_TOO_LARGE: The file behind the link is larger than {max_mb} MB. Use a smaller file or split it.
errors.URL_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: The link doesn't lead to a PDF, a web page or a text or Markdown file. Use a link that points straight to such a document.

notices.PAGES_WITHOUT_TEXT: {count, plural, one {# page without text is not searched.} other {# pages without text are not searched.}}
notices.PAGES_SKIPPED: {count, plural, one {# page could not be read and is not searched.} other {# pages could not be read and are not searched.}}
notices.PDF_ACTIVE_CONTENT: Contains active content such as scripts, which is never run.
notices.SCANNER_STARTING: The virus check is still starting. The file will be checked in a moment.
notices.SCANNER_UNAVAILABLE: The virus check is not reachable right now. The file waits until it is back.
notices.SOURCES_PARTIAL: {count, plural, one {# document is still processing and isn't included in this answer.} other {# documents are still processing and aren't included in this answer.}}
notices.CONTEXT_REDUCED: The documents are too large for this model. The answer is based on the most relevant passages.
notices.SUMMARY_PARTIAL: There is too much text for a full summary. The answer is based on the most relevant passages.
notices.NO_CITATIONS: This answer has no citations. Check it carefully.
notices.ANSWER_TRUNCATED: The answer was very long and got cut off.
notices.LLM_REFUSED: Claude can't answer this request. Try rephrasing it.
notices.LLM_NOT_CONFIGURED: Without an API key there is no answer, only the matching passages from your documents.
notices.MODEL_SWITCHED: This answer was written by {new} instead of {old}.
notices.PAGES_OCR: {count, plural, one {# page read by text recognition, highlights there are less precise.} other {# pages read by text recognition, highlights there are less precise.}}
notices.OCR_ENGINE_MISSING: Text recognition for scanned pages isn't available.
notices.OCR_RUNNING: Recognizing text on scanned pages, page {page} of {pages}.
notices.HIGHLIGHT_UNAVAILABLE: The passage can't be highlighted here. It is on page {page}.
